en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a busy European city square with a large historic building featuring a central dome, clock, and ornate façade. The square is crowded with people, market stalls with umbrellas, and an old tram on tracks running through the street. Tall spires and older buildings line the left side of the street. Caption text at the bottom left reads "GRAZ. HAUPTPLATZ" and at the bottom right "ERIKA-VERLAG – GRAZ, 1001".
